overview.description: Northern Trust New York Intermediate Tax-Exempt Bond ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to track the price and yield performance of the ICE New York Intermediate Term Focused Municipal Bond Index. The fund primarily invests in New York municipal bonds with intermediate maturities that generally provide income exempt from regular federal income tax and New York state income taxes for New York residents. It uses a representative sampling strategy and generally rebalances its portfolio in line with the underlying index.
